message:
With storm season rolling in, I've been finding myself reminiscing about the good old days when we had to entertain ourselves without all the fancy gadgets. 🌧️ I remember huddling with my family during a storm, playing cards by candlelight and telling stories that seemed to stretch on forever. It’s a great reminder that sometimes low-tech fun is the best kind. 

While it’s important to be prepared for all kinds of weather, let’s not forget to enjoy the little moments, even during a storm. I came across a handy guide that touches on flood preparedness — worth a look if you want to brush up on some practical tips. 

What’s your favorite way to keep the family entertained when the weather outside isn’t cooperating?
